vid.description: USB vendor ID of the MCP2221A bridge, as a hex string.

pid.description: USB product ID of the MCP2221A bridge, as a hex string.

pull_up.description: Use the GPIO internal pull-up; the button is wired GND to pin, so a press pulls the pin low.

debounce_ms.description: Debounce window in milliseconds that filters electrical contact noise.

long_press_threshold_sec.description: Hold time in seconds after which a press is treated as long (E-STOP while racing, reset once finished).

shutdown_press_threshold_sec.description: Kept in step with gpio.toml, which is the driver actually wired into button_node -- see its comments for why these two values are what they are.
